avatars.name: Звёздная чародейка
avatars.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production character avatar for the fantasy browser game Герои Эфира. The two input images are STYLE AND PORTRAIT COMPOSITION REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets; invent a new character. Match their polished, richly colored, friendly high-end fantasy game illustration, readable expressive face, carefully shaded materials, gold trim, crisp silhouette, elegant Prizm-inspired rendering without excessive facets. ONE character bust portrait, centered, slight three-quarter turn toward the viewer. Square 1024 composition on a TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Absolutely no scenery, background circle, frame, text, floating particles, glow outside silhouette, or cast shadow. Full head, ears, horns and any headwear must be completely visible with ample clearance from the square AND from an imaginary inscribed circular avatar crop. Keep the upper silhouette compact, roughly within x=22–78%, y=10–62%; shoulder/chest silhouette flares outward below the head, extending down to bottom edge so it can meet the bottom of a circular ball, not floating with a transparent gap below. Do not crop the head; only the lower chest can run into bottom edge. Main head fills most portrait, not a tiny head on a long torso. This is one of five cohesive PREMIUM avatars using restrained amethyst violet, midnight blue, warm gold accents and natural materials. Subject: A charismatic young adult female star sorceress with warm brown skin, bright lilac eyes, flowing deep midnight-violet hair gathered close around shoulders, delicate modest gold crescent circlet fully visible, purple velvet high-collared robe with fine celestial embroidery and one amethyst clasp. Confident warm smile, unique memorable face. No wand, no hands.
